name: 98402 · Tacoma, WA
findings: ZIP 98402 (Tacoma) has 253 nonprofit organizations. 122 of them (48%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 105 organizations.
Education organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (22% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 98402 (Tacoma) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 98402 (Tacoma) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 26.8 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 75 organizations here; 21% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
